programmes.desc: Dan and Francis pull boats for winter. Maxum replaces a ferry engine. Brad and Nathan face tricky container moves. J.P. finishes by greasing the boom.

programmes.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Under Construction"
programmes.desc: Maxum swaps a grain handler, J.P. faces a tricky lift with a contractor, Brad and Nathan lift slabs in rain, and Dave visits a theme park.

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Aluminium Cans, Cuckoo Clocks, Paddleboards"
programmes.desc: An insight into how used aluminium cans are turned into planes and rockets, and the carving of a traditional Black Forest cuckoo clock.

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Car Shredder, Sarees, Worcestershire Sauce"
programmes.desc: How do they build the ultimate car crushing colossus? Plus, how do Lea and Perrins concoct their Worcestershire sauce?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Mardi Gras, Rock Candy, Dentures"
programmes.desc: A look at how the amazing, and massive, decorations on Mardi Gras carnival floats are created, how rock candy is twisted together, and a look at how dentures are made.

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Helmets, Tea, District Heating"
programmes.desc: How do they harvest and treat the world's most expensive tea? Plus, how does the Siekierki power plant of Warsaw, Poland heat half the city's homes?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Royal Enfield, Art Fraud, Milk"
programmes.desc: How do they engineer the latest incarnation of the classic Royal Enfield Continental GT motorbike? Plus, how do 'art detectives' spot a forgery?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Crash Testing, Delftware, Umbrellas"
programmes.desc: How do they blend science and destruction at crash test centres? And how do they piece together the complex mechanism of a pocket sized umbrella?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Iron Ore, Wave Flume, Chandeliers"
programmes.desc: How do they extract iron ore from one of the most remote mines on the planet? And how do they make chandeliers that are fit for a queen?

programmes.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Oyster Knives, Stadium Lights, Diamonds"
programmes.desc: How do they forge the blades to crack open oyster shells? Plus, how do scientists in a lab grow the synthetic diamonds of the future?

programmes.title: Future Warfare S1 - "Space Warfare"
programmes.desc: Nations race to dominate outer space, deploying anti-satellite tech and space-based weaponry to secure the ultimate strategic high ground.

programmes.title: Future Warfare S1 - "Special Operations"
programmes.desc: Elite forces adapt to high-tech warfare, using advanced GPS and remote tools while facing adversaries armed with cheap, off-the-shelf tech.

programmes.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Up and Atom"
programmes.desc: This week's experiments blow open the science behind creating a glowing pickle, how forensic teams extract DNA, and how acids can transform simple household items to their core.

programmes.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Hot Hot Heat"
programmes.desc: This week's experiments investigate how to send secret messages with heat, how a little bit of melted candle wax can turn into a bomb, and why heat is an essential ingredient in cooking an egg.

programmes.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Explosive Elements"
programmes.desc: This week's experiments include recreating a big bang with lithium, the incendiary power of methane, and how a little bit of liquified nitrogen can lend a lot of power to a rocket.

programmes.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Colorful Conundrums"
programmes.desc: This week's experiments highlight how electricity can tint titanium, how you can create a color wheel by lighting things on fire, and why the world gets all its colors from white light.

programmes.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Increasing Orbit"
programmes.desc: The ISS is the workhorse of the international spacefaring community, but its days are numbered. Replacement space stations are on the drawing board. However, with commercial interests these stations will add tourism and manufacturing to the mix.

programmes.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Mountains In The Dark"
programmes.desc: Asteroids, the debris from the early solar system hold tantalizing clues to planetary formation. The spacecraft Psyche readies to study a unique metallic asteroid. As Lucy is on its way to the trojan asteroids that share Jupiter’s orbit.

programmes.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Oceans in the Sky"
programmes.desc: Juice and the Europa Clipper are two missions to our Solar System’s largest planet. They will spend over four years studying Jupiter’s atmosphere, magnetosphere and in particular its icy moons, investigating if they hold oceans suitable for life.

programmes.title: The New Frontier S5 - "Webb of life"
programmes.desc: The James Webb Space Telescope is now operational. Launched aboard an Arianne 5 the 10-billion-dollar spacecraft has deployed successfully and reached its orbit around the Sun. Soon Webb will make some findings and pose new questions to be answered.

programmes.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "Conceiving Consciousness"
programmes.desc: Simone Giertz, Reggie Watts, & Naomi Fitter, join Dianna for an exploration of what consciousness is & whether it can ever be understood. Also, a robot tells jokes.

programmes.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "Randomness & Probability"
programmes.desc: Comedian Maz Jobrani & Blackjack legend Mike Aponte play the odds, meanwhile, Dianna finds order in chaos, and just maybe hacks the stock market.

programmes.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "Truth & Logical Paradox"
programmes.desc: Dianna dives through the looking glass in this paradoxical exploration of truth itself, where the left could be right, & right might be wrong. w/ guest Zach Pincince.

programmes.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "The Infinite"
programmes.desc: Kyle Hill & Eugenia Cheng join the show to prove there is more than one infinity, that infinity is hidden all around us, & that we might actually be infinite ourselves.

programmes.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Tales of the Cosmos"

programmes.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "How Spacecraft Missions End"
